levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A role is picked, a custom role is described in one line, and every teammate is listed with their role.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A role is picked or teammates are listed, but not both.

criterion: Your Role: Role and team named

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The image shows this student's own work, the dimension is a real number with units and says what it controls, and the summary names what got done and the next step.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The image shows the student's work, but the dimension has no units or purpose, or the summary names no next step.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: No image is attached, or the answers would fit any student in the room.

criterion: Your Work: Work shown with a real number
